author: PocketsDude
body:
My in-game name is PocketsDude.

I was TempBanned for 2 weeks by the moderator MLGPorky for "Excessive Infractions + Spawn Blocking". Just like my infractions I think this is excessive. This was also a misunderstanding. I built a wall around spawn with a clear path to get out to only help my team and to stop them from getting shot by the other team the second they got out of spawn. For my Infractions I have 3 things to say. 1. Many of them are excessive. 2.I was warned for caps and temp banned b4 for spam, and 3. This is my favorite server and I make mistakes I'm only human. The only reason it is that big is because I play on this server a lot. So I am sorry for 1, trying to help my team and 2 that this is my favorite server……



EDIT: this second paragraph includes why I was banned and if I think it was fair.
        
                                     

                            Yours Truly PD

replies.body:
Hello,

This appeal is denied.

Reason: You have had multiple infractions which tells me that you cannot follow simple rules. 

This infraction is valid and you'll just have to wait it out. Temp-ban ends May 10th.

Regards,
Lord_Draksis
